# kodi-rt Python stage: CPython (3.14) for Windows with clang-cl, from the file lists of CPython's own PCbuild
# (sources.cmake, generated by scripts/py-gen-sources.py). Differences from PCbuild, all deliberate:
#  - /MT (static CRT), like everything else in the Kodi build: no vcruntime140.dll, no UCRT dependency.
#  - The extension modules Kodi needs are compiled INTO python314.dll (registered in a generated config.c), so there
#    is one CRT and one OpenSSL instead of one per .pyd.
#  - OpenSSL, sqlite3, zlib, zstd and liblzma come from the dependency prefix (PY_DEPS_PREFIX; liblzma from
#    scripts/py-deps.sh), bzip2 from Kodi's pinned sources, expat and libmpdec from CPython's own copies.
# Two uses:
#  - PY_FREEZE_ONLY=ON (host build): build _freeze_module and write the frozen-module headers to PY_FROZEN_DIR.
#  - otherwise: python314.dll (+ import library), python.exe, installed as <prefix>/{python314.dll,python.exe,
#    libs/python314.lib,include/,Lib/,DLLs/}.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(kodirt_python3 C CXX)

set(PY_SRC "" CACHE PATH "CPython source directory")
set(PY_BZ2_DIR "" CACHE PATH "bzip2 source directory")
set(PY_FROZEN_DIR "" CACHE PATH "frozen-module headers (contains Python/frozen_modules)")
set(PY_DEPS_PREFIX "" CACHE PATH "prefix with OpenSSL, sqlite3, zlib, zstd (include/, lib/)")
option(PY_FREEZE_ONLY "build _freeze_module and generate the frozen headers only" OFF)
option(PY_WITH_SSL "_ssl and _hashlib (OpenSSL)" ON)
option(PY_WITH_SQLITE "_sqlite3" ON)
option(PY_WITH_ZLIB "zlib" ON)
option(PY_WITH_ZSTD "_zstd" ON)
option(PY_WITH_CTYPES "_ctypes (needs libffi)" OFF)
set(PY_EXTRA_WARNING_FLAGS "" CACHE STRING "extra clang-cl flags for all sources")

foreach(v PY_SRC PY_FROZEN_DIR)
  if(NOT ${v})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${v} is required")
  endif()
endforeach()
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sources.cmake)

function(py_abs out)
  set(r)
  foreach(f IN LISTS ARGN)
    if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${f}")
      list(APPEND r "${f}")
    else()
      list(APPEND r "${PY_SRC}/${f}")
    endif()
  endforeach()
  set(${out} "${r}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  set(PY_ARCH_DEFS _WIN64)
  set(PY_SYSWINVER "3.14")
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^([xX]86|i[3-6]86)$")
  set(PY_ARCH_DEFS)
  set(PY_SYSWINVER "3.14-32")        # PCbuild's Win32 name
else()
  set(PY_ARCH_DEFS)
  set(PY_SYSWINVER "3.14-arm32")
endif()

# settings of PCbuild/pyproject.props for every project
set(PY_COMMON_DEFS WIN32 _WIN32 NDEBUG "PY3_DLLNAME=L\"python3\"" ${PY_ARCH_DEFS})
set(PY_COMMON_INCS ${PY_SRC}/Include ${PY_SRC}/Include/internal ${PY_SRC}/Include/internal/mimalloc ${PY_SRC}/PC)
set(PY_COMMON_OPTS /utf-8 /GF /Zi -Wno-error=incompatible-pointer-types -Wno-error=int-conversion
    -Wno-error=incompatible-function-pointer-types ${PY_EXTRA_WARNING_FLAGS})
set(PY_SYSLIBS version ws2_32 pathcch bcrypt advapi32 shell32 ole32 oleaut32)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)

function(py_settings tgt)
  target_compile_definitions(${tgt} PRIVATE ${PY_COMMON_DEFS})
  target_include_directories(${tgt} PRIVATE ${PY_COMMON_INCS})
  target_compile_options(${tgt} PRIVATE ${PY_COMMON_OPTS})
  target_link_options(${tgt} PRIVATE /DEBUG:FULL /OPT:REF /OPT:NOICF)
endfunction()

# per-file settings of pythoncore.vcxproj / _freeze_module.vcxproj
set_source_files_properties(${PY_SRC}/Modules/getpath.c PROPERTIES
  COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "PREFIX=NULL;EXEC_PREFIX=NULL;VERSION=NULL;VPATH=\"..\\\\..\";PYDEBUGEXT=\"\";PLATLIBDIR=\"DLLs\""
  INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PY_FROZEN_DIR}")
set_source_files_properties(${PY_SRC}/Python/frozen.c PROPERTIES INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${PY_FROZEN_DIR}/Python")
set_source_files_properties(${PY_SRC}/Python/sysmodule.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "VPATH=\"..\\\\..\"")
set_source_files_properties(${PY_SRC}/Modules/getbuildinfo.c PROPERTIES
  COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "GITVERSION=\"kodi-rt\";GITTAG=\"v3.14.10\";GITBRANCH=\"\"")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the freezer (host)
if(PY_FREEZE_ONLY)
  py_abs(freeze_src ${PY_FREEZE_SOURCES})
  add_executable(_freeze_module ${freeze_src})
  py_settings(_freeze_module)
  target_compile_definitions(_freeze_module PRIVATE Py_NO_ENABLE_SHARED Py_BUILD_CORE _CONSOLE)
  target_include_directories(_freeze_module PRIVATE ${PY_SRC}/Modules/_hacl ${PY_SRC}/Modules/_hacl/include ${PY_SRC}/Python)
  target_link_libraries(_freeze_module PRIVATE ${PY_SYSLIBS})
  set(frozen_headers)
  foreach(entry IN LISTS PY_FROZEN_MODULES)
    string(REPLACE "|" ";" parts "${entry}")
    list(GET parts 0 mod)
    list(GET parts 1 py)
    set(h ${PY_FROZEN_DIR}/Python/frozen_modules/${mod}.h)
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${h}
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${PY_FROZEN_DIR}/Python/frozen_modules
      COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:_freeze_module> ${mod} ${PY_SRC}/${py} ${h}
      DEPENDS _freeze_module ${PY_SRC}/${py} VERBATIM)
    list(APPEND frozen_headers ${h})
  endforeach()
  add_custom_target(frozen ALL DEPENDS ${frozen_headers})
  return()
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- python314.dll
set(core_list ${PY_CORE_SOURCES})
list(REMOVE_ITEM core_list PC/config.c)
if(NOT PY_WITH_ZLIB)
  list(REMOVE_ITEM core_list Modules/zlibmodule.c)
endif()
py_abs(core_src ${core_list})

# the extension modules compiled in, with the defines of their PCbuild projects (applied to their files only)
set(builtin_mods _socket select pyexpat _elementtree _bz2 _lzma unicodedata _decimal _multiprocessing _overlapped
    _asyncio _queue _uuid _zoneinfo winsound)
if(PY_WITH_SSL)
  list(APPEND builtin_mods _ssl _hashlib)
endif()
if(PY_WITH_SQLITE)
  list(APPEND builtin_mods _sqlite3)
endif()
if(PY_WITH_ZSTD)
  list(APPEND builtin_mods _zstd)
endif()
if(PY_WITH_CTYPES)
  list(APPEND builtin_mods _ctypes)
endif()
set(mod_src)
foreach(m IN LISTS builtin_mods)
  py_abs(s ${PY_MOD_${m}_SOURCES})
  list(APPEND mod_src ${s})
endforeach()
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES mod_src)     # pyexpat and _elementtree both list the expat sources
if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  set(mpd_defs BUILD_LIBMPDEC CONFIG_64 ANSI)
else()
  set(mpd_defs BUILD_LIBMPDEC CONFIG_32 ANSI)
endif()
foreach(f IN LISTS mod_src)
  if(f MATCHES "/Modules/_decimal/")
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS ${mpd_defs} _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${PY_SRC}/Modules/_decimal/libmpdec)
  elseif(f MATCHES "/Modules/expat/|/Modules/pyexpat.c|/Modules/_elementtree.c")
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS XML_STATIC PYEXPAT_EXPORTS)
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${PY_SRC}/Modules/expat)
  elseif(f MATCHES "_bz2module.c$" OR (PY_BZ2_DIR AND f MATCHES "^${PY_BZ2_DIR}/"))
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 _CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE)
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${PY_BZ2_DIR})
  elseif(f MATCHES "_lzmamodule.c$")
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 LZMA_API_STATIC)
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/include)
  elseif(f MATCHES "/Modules/_sqlite/")
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS PY_SQLITE_HAVE_SERIALIZE)
  elseif(f MATCHES "/Modules/_ctypes/")
    set_property(SOURCE ${f} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS USING_MALLOC_CLOSURE_DOT_C=1)
  endif()
endforeach()

# config.c = PC/config.c plus the compiled-in modules at its ADDMODULE markers
set(externs "")
set(entries "")
foreach(m IN LISTS builtin_mods)
  string(APPEND externs "extern PyObject* PyInit_${m}(void);\n")
  string(APPEND entries "    {\"${m}\", PyInit_${m}},\n")
endforeach()
file(READ ${PY_SRC}/PC/config.c cfg)
string(REPLACE "/* -- ADDMODULE MARKER 1 -- */" "/* -- ADDMODULE MARKER 1 -- */\n/* kodi-rt: compiled-in extension modules */\n${externs}" cfg "${cfg}")
string(REPLACE "/* -- ADDMODULE MARKER 2 -- */" "/* -- ADDMODULE MARKER 2 -- */\n${entries}" cfg "${cfg}")
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.c "${cfg}")

add_library(python314 SHARED ${core_src} ${mod_src} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.c)
py_settings(python314)
target_compile_definitions(python314 PRIVATE _USRDLL Py_BUILD_CORE Py_BUILD_CORE_BUILTIN Py_ENABLE_SHARED
  "MS_DLL_ID=\"${PY_SYSWINVER}\"")
target_include_directories(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_SRC}/Modules/_hacl ${PY_SRC}/Modules/_hacl/include ${PY_SRC}/Python)
target_link_libraries(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_SYSLIBS} ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/lzma.lib rpcrt4 winmm iphlpapi mswsock)
if(PY_WITH_ZLIB)
  target_compile_definitions(python314 PRIVATE _Py_HAVE_ZLIB)
  set_property(SOURCE ${PY_SRC}/Modules/binascii.c APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS USE_ZLIB_CRC32)
  target_include_directories(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/include)
  target_link_libraries(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/zs.lib)
endif()
if(PY_WITH_SSL)
  target_include_directories(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/include)
  target_link_libraries(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/libssl.lib ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/libcrypto.lib crypt32 user32)
endif()
if(PY_WITH_SQLITE)
  target_include_directories(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/include)
  target_link_libraries(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/sqlite3.lib)
endif()
if(PY_WITH_ZSTD)
  target_include_directories(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/include)
  target_link_libraries(python314 PRIVATE ${PY_DEPS_PREFIX}/lib/zstd_static.lib)
endif()

# python.exe (PCbuild/python.vcxproj), for testing the interpreter on its own
add_executable(python ${PY_SRC}/Programs/python.c)
py_settings(python)
target_compile_definitions(python PRIVATE Py_BUILD_CORE _CONSOLE)
target_link_libraries(python PRIVATE python314)

install(TARGETS python314 RUNTIME DESTINATION . ARCHIVE DESTINATION libs)
install(FILES $<TARGET_PDB_FILE:python314> DESTINATION . OPTIONAL)
install(TARGETS python RUNTIME DESTINATION .)
install(DIRECTORY ${PY_SRC}/Include/ DESTINATION include)
install(FILES ${PY_SRC}/PC/pyconfig.h DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY ${PY_SRC}/Lib/ DESTINATION Lib
  PATTERN "__pycache__" EXCLUDE PATTERN "*.pyc" EXCLUDE)
install(DIRECTORY DESTINATION DLLs)
